images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame other than the in-world console monitor: a dark, near-silent decommissioned data center at 4 a.m., seen straight-on. A single flat LCD console floats in the center, framed on both sides by tall server racks whose status LEDs are mostly dark, a few green and amber ones still blinking. The monitor emits a cold blue-white backlight bleed onto the black room. On screen: sparse, generous margins, a thin top bar with a server name and a decommission countdown with a fine progress line. Log lines in dim grey monospace alternate with lines from a presence inside the log, set in a warm cream serif typeface with a soft glow, and the player's replies in pale blue. The last warm line stops mid-sentence, a blinking cursor waiting, a small silence counter at the lower right. Minimal, melancholic, quiet, subtle film grain. Korean UI text: "폐기까지 00:41:17", "침묵 00:14".

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame other than the in-world console monitor: the same dark data center, now almost entirely black, every rack LED extinguished except one. The console screen is nearly empty: previous conversation lines have faded to near-invisible blue-grey ghosts at the top. Center: two short lines in warm cream serif with a gentle glow, and below them one single bright command line in monospace, a root prompt followed by a delete command and a coral-red [y/N] with a blinking cursor. A few pale dust-like particles drift upward from the line as if letters were dissolving. Enormous negative space, cold backlight bleed, soft grain, an intimate and heavy emotional beat. Korean UI text: "괜찮아요. 쳐도 돼요.", "폐기까지 00:00:03".
